description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate any identified vulnerabilities to ensure the application is secure before deployment.
tasks.reason: The project uses several outdated dependencies (Spring Boot 1.5.9, org.json 20171018, commons-io 2.6, commons-lang3 3.7) that may carry known CVEs. Remediating these reduces the attack surface before deploying to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. If a CVE fix requires a major version upgrade, document the affected dependency, the current version, the upgraded major version, and the breaking change risk. Verify that the project builds and all tests pass after remediation.

tasks.description: Containerize the uportal-messaging application and deploy it to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: Moving from an on-premises WAR deployment to Azure Container Apps provides scalable, cloud-native hosting with managed infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Create a Dockerfile for the Spring Boot application. Provision an Azure Container Apps environment and container app resource. Deploy the built container image. Use Managed Identity for any Azure resource access.
tasks.resourceStatus: Create new Azure Container Apps environment and container app
